category_edits.rationale: Scale input item embeddings by a bounded training-frequency feature computed separately for each dataset. This may distinguish established preferences from rare events while preserving learned embeddings, SASRec topology, readout, loss and optimizer. The feature is a checkpoint buffer; the embedded predictor imports SASRec and loads it automatically, preserving identical inference.

training_counts = np.zeros(itemnum + 1, dtype=np.float64)
    for history in user_train.values():
        np.add.at(training_counts, np.asarray(history, dtype=np.int64), 1.0)
    training_counts[0] = 0.0
    log_counts = np.log1p(training_counts)
    denominator = max(float(log_counts.max()), 1e-12)
    frequency_scale = 0.75 + 0.5 * log_counts / denominator
    frequency_scale[0] = 0.0
    with torch.no_grad():
        model.input_frequency_scale.copy_(torch.as_tensor(
            frequency_scale,
            dtype=model.input_frequency_scale.dtype,
            device=device,
